Description: **Huawei Cloud Elastic Load Balance (ELB)** application listeners use **HTTPS** (`HTTPS` or `TERMINATED_HTTPS`) rather than unencrypted **HTTP**.
Risk: Plaintext **HTTP** listeners transmit requests, session tokens, and sensitive payloads unencrypted, exposing traffic to eavesdropping and man-in-the-middle attacks.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the **Huawei Cloud console**.
2. Navigate to **Elastic Load Balance (ELB)** > **Load Balancers**.
3. Select the load balancer and go to the **Listeners** tab.
4. Replace plaintext **HTTP** listeners with **HTTPS** listeners.

Recommendation.Text: Use **HTTPS** listeners on ELB load balancers and redirect any HTTP traffic to HTTPS.
